beliefs: For x>=1 the positive branch is 10.4·x + 0.5·x^2 exactly at integer powers and large x (1→10.6, 2→20.7, 4→46.9, 128→1671.3) [E1]

In 1<x<2 the observed values are erratic and don't follow a smooth formula (1.05→9.255, 1.35→13.185, 1.45→13.495, 1.65→16.115, 1.9→20.39, 1.95→20.045) — looks like noise or a hidden oscillation [E3, E4]
Above x≈2 the values again track 10.4x+0.5x^2 closely (2.1→24.01, 2.6→28.56, 3.25→38.075) [E4]
For x<0, f is roughly linear with slope ≈1.4 and intercept ≈-10, but noisy (values scatter around the trend) [E1, E2]
The erratic 1<x<2 region is unexplained; a best guess is the quadratic plus noise? [E4]
notes: E4 shows the 1<x<2 region is not a smooth shifted rule; values jump around (e.g. 1.3→14.53 then 1.35→13.185). Kept the quadratic for x>=2 and the linear rule for x<1, and left the 1<x<2 band as quadratic-with-noise guess.
